text: I went there for a filling, and the dentist was incredibly fast with each case. I don't know why they were in such a hurry. In the end, my tooth sensitivity is still the same, like I didn't even get a filling. It was a complete waste of time. Going to Nong Chok Hospital would be better. And the clinic owner even commented to the patient, "You've had braces before, haven't you worn your retainer? Your teeth look crooked and sticking out." Is that even appropriate?
